reason: Compact technical synonym for selected share, but can be misread as filtrate or physical separation.
Selected material share keeps every R/N and AR/OR contrast, supports recursion and measurement, and does not claim separation.
N already carries grade/stage values; the stage renderer makes six exact R/N pairs near-synonymous and measures a stage rather than material.
A selected material class is possible, but nested classes and measured classes are less direct than selected shares.
